test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I can't believe you_____ that old trick!
solution:
The correct answer is '**fell for**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrasal verb "**fell for**" means to be deceived by something or someone, or to believe something that is not true.
 
• The sentence expresses disbelief that someone was tricked, so "**fell for**" is the most appropriate choice.
